4 اسقمهُ , (S, Msb, TA,) inf. n. إِسْقَامٌ; (TA;) and ↓ سقّمهُ , (Msb, TA,) inf. n. تَسْقِيمٌ; (TA;) He (God) [or it] caused him to be, or become, diseased, disordered, distempered, sick, or ill: (S, TA:) or caused him to be long diseased &c. (Msb.) ＝
-A2- And أَسْقَمَ الرَّجُلُ The man had his family affected with diseases, and the diseases came afterwards upon him. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
